name: coverage-compression-v2
development: 1024 uniformly sampled windows from previously exposed validation documents [0,4096)
audit: 2048 uniformly sampled windows from new validation documents [4096,8192)
strict_success: Candidate artifact is smaller; paired mean audit loss difference is <=0 at 400 updates.
evidence_requirement: One-sided paired 95% Student-t upper bound <=0.01 nats/token across eight training seeds.
selection: Freeze one finalist before audit access. Require two search seeds and prefer smallest artifact with mean development loss <= matched full-pool mean.
accounting: Uncompressed uint16 serialized token payload. No external assets during training. Report construction cost separately.
initial_search: Random, teacher-loss, learnability, and stratified coverage selection across 50%,75%,87.5% pools. Adaptive refinements use development loss only.
audit_policy: No candidate search may read the new audit. A failed audit becomes development evidence; further confirmation needs another reserved split.
